title: Immortality_Mod
description: This is my first Minecraft mod I have made by myself. It is probably very buggy and I'm planning to fix any problems in the future!
body:
# First Mod

Hello! This is the first mod I have made by myself. I am still kind of new to making mods, so this is a big learning project for me. It might not be perfect, and there are probably a lot of bugs, but I tried my best to make something fun and working.

Right now the mod is still in beta, which means it is not finished yet. Some things might not work properly, and you might run into glitches or weird problems while using it. If that happens, don’t worry — I am planning to fix bugs and improve things over time as I learn more.

I also want to add more features in the future to make the mod better and more interesting. This is just the start, so there will definitely be updates.

Thanks for trying out my mod, and I hope you enjoy it!
